immutable_candidate_rules: reviewed candidate authority is content-addressed by exact Git blob SHA, not by mutable branch name
if PR #283 head changes, every changed workflow blob must be re-reviewed and this plan must be regenerated
a successful hosted CI run must execute repository steps against the exact reviewed PR head; pre-runner failures do not qualify
after merge, default-branch workflow blobs must equal the exact reviewed candidate blob SHAs before any controller projection using them is installed
controller policy and deployment generation must bind the exact merged default-branch blobs before either offline class controller is activated
merging workflow bytes alone grants no root/controller/live authority
required_authorities: explicit Research GPU containment/recovery authority that identifies the exact inherited quarantine/retry state being consumed
explicit default-branch producer cutover authority for Research Engine PR #283 or an exact successor head
explicit Lambda v3 live migration authority for the exact workspace-control generation
accepted migration-canary receipts for both offline model classes under the frozen generation-exclusion protocol
preflight: verify Research Engine PR head equals reviewed_head and is mergeable without content drift
verify GitHub-hosted CI on reviewed_head completed success with a nonzero runner_id and repository steps
verify reviewed candidate workflow blob SHAs exactly match the PR head files
verify current Research Engine main workflow blobs exactly match old_blob_sha values
verify no unreviewed workflow/default-branch changes affect either route
verify all legacy v2 project controllers are stopped/drained and no legacy transient runner exists before any target v3 controller activation
verify no v3 class controller/transient/resource claim exists before entering the cutover transaction
verify inherited Research GPU containment and invalidated retry state exactly match the separately authorized recovery receipt
transaction_order: freeze exact reviewed PR head, old default-branch blobs, reviewed candidate blobs, workspace-control control-plane generation, and all authority receipts
quiesce/drain generations exactly as required by the existing v2/v3 generation-exclusion transaction
perform the separately authorized Research Engine default-branch merge/cutover
read Research Engine main and prove both default-branch workflow blobs equal the reviewed candidate blob SHAs; abort activation on any mismatch
compile/verify the exact controller projections and deployment generation that bind those merged workflow blobs to their homogeneous offline runner classes
install policy/deployment material while both offline class controllers remain inactive
prove Research GPU containment recovery authority is valid for this exact transaction before activating any Research GPU-derived class
activate at most the separately authorized offline class controller(s) in the frozen migration order
run only the separately authorized bounded synthetic acceptance workflow and collect broker/cgroup/cleanup evidence

prove TotalAssignedJobs returns to zero, no runner/broker transient remains, resource ledger is empty, and containment/retry state is exactly the authorized post-state before declaring cutover accepted

rollback.principle: workflow/default-branch rollback and runtime-generation rollback are separate; neither may implicitly resurrect legacy Research GPU execution
before_default_branch_merge: stop/drain any target v3 controller that was started during preflight
restore exact pre-transaction inactive controller/policy state
after_default_branch_merge_before_accept: stop/drain all target v3 controllers and prove no v3 transient/resource claim remains
create/merge an explicitly authorized revert that restores the exact old workflow bytes/labels and verify resulting blobs equal old_blob_sha values
restore old workspace-control workflow/controller policy generation only after exact blob proof
keep legacy Research GPU controller stopped/contained; do not restore the old crash loop or retry authority
after_v3_execution_started: contain target v3 class and force/await terminal cleanup
prove broker unit, runner unit, JIT registration, and root resource claim are all terminal/absent
then perform the exact workflow/policy rollback sequence
preserve Research GPU containment unless a separate authority explicitly defines a different safe post-state

forbidden: do not merge PR #283 merely because repository-only review passed
do not treat hosted CI runner-allocation failures as test success
do not install a controller projection that trusts proposal blobs before those exact blobs are present on the owning default branch
do not activate an offline class controller before exact workflow blob/policy/deployment binding
do not restart the legacy research-engine GPU v2 controller during rollback
do not clear or recreate READY_FOR_SINGLE_RETRY or RECOVERY_RETRY_ACQUIRED authority
do not dispatch candidate/scientific work as part of the cutover helper itself
